evidence_interpretation.narrative: Lane convergence, not a tuning change: the RTX 5090 container lane moves from the feat/warm-arrival branch head d956e6d6 (shipped v0.5.1 through v0.6.1) onto the mainline runtime at 63f28c95 - the same commit both native Windows lanes now build from - on the unchanged v0.4.8 argument set (--max-private-continuations 8 --device-state-slots 4 --host-state-slots 24). The candidate was qualified on 2026-09-10 against an appliance-built image (EXP-030, 7/7 gates), and every gate that a published artifact can answer was then re-run on 2026-09-11 against the published image pulled anonymously by digest. Throughput is within run-to-run noise of v0.5.1 (prefill 2,169.9 published / 2,144.1 candidate / 2,180.3 on v0.5.1; decode 132.53 / 133.3 / 133.13), which is the result the shared tree had to produce: the native lanes' changes reach the container lane with no measurable effect on it.

agent_protocol.measured_on: the published image, and again on the candidate

fanout_acceptance.gate: four stored sibling forks of one template reuse the base anchor in one process and again after a verified restart, at two template sizes
fanout_acceptance.measured_on: the appliance-built candidate; the published image carries these by binary identity

warm_arrival.gate: after a verified restart every sibling fork of a restored template is served on the shared anchor whether an endpoint resume or a fork arrives first, and every resume quotes the planted ledger keys exactly

lifecycle.note: candidate and published-image runs were both preflighted and started through tools/lifecycle/ninfer_container.py with image id, binary, model artifact and configuration identity bound; preflight refuses while the loopback port is held, which is the fail-closed sequencing the window script exists for. The configuration identity computed from the published image's config equals the candidate's, so the profile did not drift between qualification and publication.

origin_authentication.basis: manifest MAC publication and verification are store-format behaviour this change does not touch; the tamper round loaded a MAC-tagged generation and refused it on the streamed payload digest

checkpoint_scheduling.note: explicit saves of a 5.2 GB session stayed near four seconds across two settle cycles; automatic queue behaviour unchanged (store schema 2)

scope_exclusions: the fanout, warm-arrival and restore probes were measured on the candidate image built from these exact bytes on the appliance, before the published image existed; every gate a published artifact can answer (retrieval, decode, agent protocol across a restart, identity, auth boundary, completion) was re-run on the pulled image and the served binary hash is identical
no RTX 4090 or RTX 3090 change: the 4090 carries v0.6.1 and the 3090 v0.2.5 unchanged, and the 3090 mainline candidate waits for its host

alphastorm/ninfer#42 is fixed after these bytes (29caaf34) and is not in this release; it is over-provisioning on devices with fewer resident CTAs than the preferred split, latent on the 5090, 4090 and 3090 SM counts

durable_qualification.note: store format unchanged (schema 2); this release changes which source tree the lane is built from, not what it writes
